create or replace view ML_LTV_SCORE_V( ⏎ 	LTV_TYPE, ⏎ 	LTV_TYPE_NAME, ⏎ 	SERIES_CD, ⏎ 	SERIES_NAME, ⏎ 	STDR_MT, ⏎ 	HIST_TOTAL_AMT, ⏎ 	FUTURE_TOTAL_AMT, ⏎ 	LTV, ⏎ 	AVG_MONTHLY_FORECAST, ⏎ 	AVG_MONTHLY_ACTUAL, ⏎ 	ACTIVE_MONTHS ⏎ ) COMMENT='ML LTV 스코어 2종(계열당 1행). UCMPGN=상위캠페인 · CMPGN=일반캠페인. 월별 예측 뷰와 grain 이 달라 합산하지 않는다. 단위=원. 예측치이며 실적이 아니다.' ⏎  as ⏎ SELECT 'UCMPGN_AVG_MEMBER'      AS LTV_TYPE, ⏎        '상위캠페인 회원평균 LTV'  AS LTV_TYPE_NAME, ⏎        u.UPPER_CMPGN_CD          AS SERIES_CD, ⏎        cm_u.CMPGN_NM             AS SERIES_NAME, ⏎        u.STDR_MT, u.HIST_TOTAL_AMT, u.FUTURE_TOTAL_AMT, u.LTV, ⏎        u.AVG_MONTHLY_FORECAST, u.AVG_MONTHLY_ACTUAL, u.ACTIVE_MONTHS ⏎ FROM GN_DW.ML.ML_RST_DATA_UCMPGN_LTV_SCORE u ⏎ LEFT JOIN GN_DW.SILVER.CRM_CAMPAIGN cm_u ON cm_u.CMPGN_CD = u.UPPER_CMPGN_CD ⏎ UNION ALL ⏎ SELECT 'CMPGN_TOTAL', ⏎        '캠페인 후원총액 LTV', ⏎        c.CMPGN_CD, ⏎        cm_c.CMPGN_NM, ⏎        c.STDR_MT, c.HIST_TOTAL_AMT, c.FUTURE_TOTAL_AMT, c.LTV, ⏎        c.AVG_MONTHLY_FORECAST, c.AVG_MONTHLY_ACTUAL, c.ACTIVE_MONTHS ⏎ FROM GN_DW.ML.ML_RST_DATA_CMPGN_LTV_SCORE c ⏎ LEFT JOIN GN_DW.SILVER.CRM_CAMPAIGN cm_c ON cm_c.CMPGN_CD = c.CMPGN_CD;
